preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
The integer K must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S must be lowercase Latin characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the string representation of the return value.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= K and return_value <= len(S))
postconditions.description: The return value must be -1 if no valid substring exists, otherwise it must be between K and the length of S.

postconditions.expression: any(len(set(S[i:j+1])) == K for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)))
postconditions.description: There must exist at least one substring with exactly K distinct characters if the return value is not -1.
